description: This file contains helper functions and types for managing SQL database connections and transactions, including re-binding queries based on database mode, and executing queries with context support.

classes.name: sqlDatabase
classes.description: A wrapper around *sql.DB that provides additional methods and mode awareness for different SQL dialects.

classes.name: sqlTx
classes.description: A wrapper around *sql.Tx that provides methods for executing queries with automatic rebinding based on mode.

methods.name: newSQLDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new sqlDatabase instance wrapping an existing *sql.DB with a specified mode.

methods.name: sqlDatabase.Mode
methods.description: Returns the mode of the database, e.g., 'postgres'.

methods.name: sqlDatabase.Begin
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction with default options.

methods.name: sqlDatabase.BeginTx
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction with specific options and context.

methods.name: sqlDatabase.rebind
methods.description: Rebinds SQL queries based on the database mode, replacing placeholders as needed.

methods.name: sqlDatabase.ExecContext
methods.description: Executes a query with context, after rebinding query string.

methods.name: sqlDatabase.Exec
methods.description: Executes a query without context, after rebinding query string.

methods.name: sqlDatabase.QueryContext
methods.description: Performs a query with context, after rebinding query string.

methods.name: sqlDatabase.Query
methods.description: Performs a query without context, after rebinding query string.

methods.name: sqlDatabase.QueryRowContext
methods.description: Fetches a single row with context, after rebinding query string.

methods.name: sqlDatabase.QueryRow
methods.description: Fetches a single row without context, after rebinding query string.

methods.name: sqlDatabase.PrepareContext
methods.description: Prepares a statement with context, after rebinding query string.

methods.name: newSQLTx
methods.description: Creates a new sqlTx object wrapping an existing *sql.Tx with mode.

methods.name: sqlTx.rebind
methods.description: Rebinds queries based on the transaction's mode, similar to sqlDatabase.rebind.

methods.name: sqlTx.ExecContext
methods.description: Executes a command with context using the transaction, after rebinding query.

methods.name: sqlTx.Exec
methods.description: Executes a command without context using the transaction, after rebinding query.

methods.name: sqlTx.QueryContext
methods.description: Performs a query with context within the transaction, after rebinding query.

methods.name: sqlTx.Query
methods.description: Performs a query without context within the transaction, after rebinding query.

methods.name: sqlTx.QueryRowContext
methods.description: Fetches a single row with context within the transaction, after rebinding query.

methods.name: sqlTx.QueryRow
methods.description: Fetches a single row without context within the transaction, after rebinding query.
